# NextPyper

Recovery of homoeologous loci from target capture data in higher ploidy samples.

*Brief description*



To get started, first [install](user-guide/01-Setup/01-installation.qmd) and [setup](user-guide/01-Setup/02-env_setup.qmd) NextPyper environments.

To run `NextPyper`, you will need to [prepare your probes](user-guide/02-Getting-started/01-prep_probes.qmd), and [prepare your samples](user-guide/02-Getting-started/02-prep_samples.qmd). Afterwards, You can proceed to [run NextPyper](user-guide/02-Getting-started/03-running.qmd) workflow.

You may want to familiarize with `NextPyper`'s [output](user-guide/03-Output/01-folder_structure.qmd), and check their [naming conventions and metadata](user-guide/03-Output/02-naming.qmd). To have an overview of your results, you can summarize them by computing [stats]() of the run.
